name: find-customers
description: B2B lead generation and customer discovery expert. Turns fuzzy requests like find me customers, who buys my product, prospecting, or expand sales channels into contactable, traceable leads. Collection-first workflow: F0 intake (get the open_key, do NOT query the store first); F1 requirement intake covering industry, product, region and buyer profile; F2 downstream industry analysis; F3 multi-source prospecting across industry portals, search engines, community channels, corporate sites and model knowledge, with source and timestamp on every entry; F4 lead sheet plus staging into the mcp.fore.vip/crm server-side store (local CSV only as an offline fallback, dedupe by company name handled server-side); F5 outreach through Agent Mail to publicly listed addresses with status write-back, plus a compensated inbound-acquisition path when leads are scarce; F6 closing question about turning the flow into a custom workflow. Compliance: public information only, never private data, no hard-sell redirect content.

displayDescription.en: B2B lead generation: requirement lock-in, downstream industry mapping, multi-source prospecting, lead staging and compliant email outreach.
displayDescription.zh: B2B 获客专家：需求锁定、产业链下游分析、多源客户采集、线索暂存与邮件合规触达。
